svg.title: Screw shaft – process flow
svg.text: Screw shaft BS-3210-1000-C5 – routing with the 3 thread variants: G ground from solid (main) · W hard whirling + finish grinding · R rolled (C7 / C10)
R: rolled screws skip thread grinding
Machines at the design point (G, 120 / day, 2 shifts, OEE 0.75):
W: 4 whirlers (84 %) + 5 thread grinders instead of 8; R: none.
